findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: world_challenge · Private data: build_transaction, get_duties, world_challenge, world_enter, world_move, world_leave · Public sink: build_transaction · Destructive: build_transaction, get_duties.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: world_challenge · Private data: build_transaction, get_duties, world_challenge, world_enter, world_move, world_leave · Public sink: build_transaction · Destructive: build_transaction, get_duties

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
